sources.title: Mozilla Common Voice
sources.notes: Record the exact release, locale, and download date. Do not attempt to identify speakers or combine metadata beyond the published dataset terms. Common Voice is not an emotion-labeled TTS corpus.

sources.title: MotherTongue direct-consent recordings
sources.notes: Use only after a speaker signs explicit recording, training, product, retention, and deletion consent. Store the consent record outside Git and reference it by a non-identifying ID.

sources.title: RAVDESS emotional speech
sources.notes: Use for research or benchmarking only unless a separate commercial permission is obtained. Do not place its audio in a production training bundle.

sources.title: EmoV-DB
sources.notes: The dataset license explicitly excludes commercial product incorporation without contacting the rights holder.

sources.title: IEMOCAP
sources.notes: Request access and read the license before downloading or using any files.
